name: Amazon Echo Show 5 (newest model, Charcoal)
caption:
Your alarm clock could do a lot more than beep. ⏰

The Echo Show 5 is a 5.5 inch smart display with Alexa. Ask for timers, music, or the weather and see the answer on screen. The newest model has 2x the bass and clearer sound.

Tip: a bedside table or kitchen counter is where it works best, as a clock and alarm.
